pair: points scored per game vs points allowed per game
mechanism_or_reason: tests whether a high-scoring club also allows more - if they were unrelated, a total and a side could be treated as separate information
how_the_desk_uses_it: a negative or nil association means totals and spreads carry largely independent information for singles
note: CI spans zero, so no association is established at n=32

pair: points scored per game vs points allowed per game
mechanism_or_reason: same test on a full season as a stability check on CR-01

pair: net points per game, previous full season vs season to date
mechanism_or_reason: how much of last season's scoring differential is still information this season
how_the_desk_uses_it: sets the shrinkage the desk is willing to apply to a prior-season rating; a low value forces season-to-date weighting

pair: points scored per game, previous season vs season to date
how_the_desk_uses_it: separates offensive continuity from defensive continuity

pair: points allowed per game, previous season vs season to date
how_the_desk_uses_it: same as CR-04 for the other side of the ball

pair: wins above points-based expectation, season to season
mechanism_or_reason: if a 'lucky' record predicted the next year, the residual would be skill rather than chance
how_the_desk_uses_it: the desk refuses records-only strategies; this is the measurement that justifies it

pair: QB passing yards over vs primary WR1 receiving yards over
mechanism_or_reason: every completion to that receiver adds identical yards to both legs, so independence is certainly wrong
how_the_desk_uses_it: pricing an SGP stack: use the Frechet ceiling min(p1,p2) and floor max(0,p1+p2-1) until a joint model exists
note: no coefficient is published because paired per-play data does not exist in this repository

pair: home spread cover vs home team total over
mechanism_or_reason: both legs are driven by the same margin; the joint probability is bounded, not factored
how_the_desk_uses_it: a parlay of these two legs is quoted as if independent when p12 lies in a wide interval

pair: two legs from different games on the same slate
mechanism_or_reason: shared elements are weather, kickoff slot and total-scoring environment; residual dependence is small but not zero
how_the_desk_uses_it: the cheapest legal multi-leg exposure, and the only parlay family this desk will price from marginals with a stated bound
